name: Cards Everywhere!
summary: 整理收纳游戏，2026 年 9 月 17 日上架，Armed Chicken 开发并发行，分类为休闲／模拟：在散落的 2000 张卡片里分拣、收集 1500 余种独特卡片并装进收藏册，边整理边解锁套装与能力。商店 AI 披露说明生成式 AI 工具在开发期协助创作收藏卡上的美术与部分 UI 元素，所有 AI 生成内容在发售前完成、由开发者策展并入游戏，游戏过程中不生成任何内容。本站据此把美术登记为已使用、游戏运行登记为明确声明未使用，其余六个领域因披露没有点名而登记为未说明。两个第三方转录页面与商店原文一致，其程度评级不采纳。所有结论只有开发者自述支撑，未经独立审计。

reviewNote: 核查英文商店页完整 AI 披露栏（未被截断）、身份（开发与发行均为 Armed Chicken，正式版，2026 年 9 月 17 日）与英文讨论区首页：可见 15 个主题、总数 42，即只覆盖首页，可见主题为设置与信件反馈等，没有 AI 相关讨论。公开报道单独检索 1 次（原始响应存档 press-search.json，6 条结果），登记并读取 2 条来源：gameaicheck.com 与 gamedb.ai 的本作条目页，两者转录的披露原文与商店一致；前者页面自带的 AI 程度与置信度评级、后者页面的标签与等级属第三方自动判断，本站不采纳。其余四条里一条是商店页（已有官方取证）、一条是需登录或前端渲染的 Steam 社区评测页、一条是其他作品的聚合站条目、一条与本作的无关旧书页。未检索到独立媒体报道，这不能证明披露之外没有 AI 用途，判定只以商店披露原文为准。

english.summary: A cosy organising game released on Sep 17, 2026, developed and published by Armed Chicken and filed under Casual and Simulation, where you sort through 2,000 scattered cards, collect more than 1,500 unique ones and fill the collection album while unlocking sets and abilities. The Steam AI disclosure states that generative AI tools supported the creation of the artwork on the collectible cards and some UI elements, that all AI generated content was created before release and curated and integrated by the developer, and that no content is generated by AI during gameplay. This site records art as used with the some UI elements limit kept and live generation as explicitly ruled out, while the other six areas stay not addressed because the disclosure never names them. The transcriptions on the two aggregator entry pages match the store text and their extent ratings are not adopted, and every finding rests on the developer own statement without independent audit.
english.reviewNote: Checked the complete English Steam AI disclosure block, the identity (Armed Chicken as both developer and publisher, a full release dated Sep 17, 2026) and the first page of the English discussion board, which shows 15 visible topics out of 42 in total, so only the front page was covered and its threads are settings and feedback with no AI topic. One dedicated web search was run, archived as press-search.json, all 6 results were dispositioned and two sources were registered and read in full, the gameaicheck.com and gamedb.ai entry pages for this game, whose transcriptions match the store text while their own confidence ratings and area labels are automatic third party judgements this site does not adopt. Of the remaining results one was the store page already covered by the official evidence, one was a Steam community review listing that needs a signed in or scripted page, one was an aggregator page for another game and one was an unrelated book scan page. No independent press report was found, which proves nothing beyond the reviewed disclosure.
